mapper.select: SELECT id,offering_id,chapter_id,title,description,estimated_minutes,type,status,is_required,due_at,late_until,allow_resubmit,max_attempts,max_score,content_version,current_ai_policy_id,published_at,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM assignments WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id,a.offering_id,o.status AS offering_status,a.chapter_id,a.title,a.type,a.is_required,a.status AS publication_state,a.description,a.due_at, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'REVIEWED' WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBMITTED' WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END AS assignment_state, s.id AS latest_submission_id,f.id AS published_feedback_id, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.recipient_id=#{studentId} AND n.related_feedback_id=f.id AND n.is_read=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unread_feedback FROM assignments a JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=a.offering_id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{studentId} AND s.is_current=1 LEFT JOIN feedback f ON f.submission_id=s.id AND f.status='published' LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.assignment_id=a.id AND w.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE m.user_id=#{studentId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND a.status IN ('published','archived') AND a.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND o.term_id=#{termId}

t.id,t.offering_id,t.offering_status,t.chapter_id,t.title,t.type,t.is_required,t.publication_state,t.description,t.due_at,t.assignment_state, CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') AND t.due_at < #{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, t.latest_submission_id,t.published_feedback_id,t.unread_feedback
mapper.select: SELECT FROM () t WHERE t.id=#{assignmentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.offering_status='active' AND t.publication_state='published' AND t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS todo_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('SUBMITTED','REVIEWED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS done_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') AND NOT (t.offering_status='active' AND t.publication_state='published') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS archived_incomplete_count FROM () t
